description: Figure: membrane-depth distribution of charged and aromatic residues in the APOOL/MIC27 AlphaFold model, and cross-species conservation of the matrix-loop basic motif
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ACC="Q6UXV4"
SEQ = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{ACC}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]
meta = requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{ACC}",timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb = requests.get(meta['pdbUrl'],timeout=120).text
t2o={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
rows=[(L[12:16].strip(),t2o[L[17:20].strip()],int(L[22:26]),float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54]),float(L[60:66]))
      for L in pdb.splitlines() if L.startswith("ATOM")]
A=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['name','aa','resi','x','y','z','b'])
def axis(df):
    X=df[['x','y','z']].values; Xc=X-X.mean(0); _,_,vt=np.linalg.svd(Xc); a=vt[0]
    return (a if np.dot(X[-1]-X[0],a)>0 else -a)
ca=A[A.name=='CA'].sort_values('resi')
n=axis(ca[(ca.resi>=111)&(ca.resi<=129)])-axis(ca[(ca.resi>=138)&(ca.resi<=155)]); n/=np.linalg.norm(n)
center=ca[((ca.resi>=111)&(ca.resi<=129))|((ca.resi>=138)&(ca.resi<=155))][['x','y','z']].values.mean(0)
if (((ca[(ca.resi>=130)&(ca.resi<=137)][['x','y','z']].values-center)@n).mean())>0: n=-n
A['zm']=(A[['x','y','z']].values-center)@n
bb={'N','CA','C','O'}
tips=[]
for resi,g in A.groupby('resi'):
    scs=g[~g.name.isin(bb)]; use=scs if len(scs) else g
    cac=g[g.name=='CA'][['x','y','z']].values[0]
    d=np.linalg.norm(use[['x','y','z']].values-cac,axis=1)
    tips.append((resi,g.aa.iloc[0],float(g[g.name=='CA'].b.values[0]),float(use.iloc[int(np.argmax(d))].zm)))
T=pd.DataFrame(tips,columns=['resi','aa','plddt','z_tip'])

# conservation of each human position across the 12 vertebrate MIC27 orthologs (from prior alignment, recomputed cheaply)
cons = {126:'L/V/F/M',127:'V/I/L/A/F',128:'S/L',129:'A/S',130:'R (11/12; K in opossum)',131:'K/R (11/12)',
        132:'G (11/12)',133:'S (12/12)',134:'K/R (12/12)',135:'F/W/L (12/12 bulky hydrophobic)',
        136:'K (12/12)',137:'K/R (12/12)',138:'I/L',139:'T/A/V',140:'Y (10/12)',141:'P (12/12)'}

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,6.2),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.45,1]})

ax=axes[0]
m=T[(T.resi>=95)&(T.resi<=195)]
colr={'K':'#2563eb','R':'#2563eb','D':'#dc2626','E':'#dc2626'}
ax.axhspan(-18,18,color='#f3e8c8',zorder=0)
ax.axhspan(-18,-10,color='#e3d4a3',zorder=0); ax.axhspan(10,18,color='#e3d4a3',zorder=0)
ax.axhline(0,color='#bba', lw=0.8, zorder=1)
for r in m.itertuples():
    c=colr.get(r.aa,'#9aa3ad'); aro = r.aa in 'WYF'
    ax.scatter(r.resi, r.z_tip, s=58 if (r.aa in 'KRDE' or aro) else 16,
               color='#16a34a' if aro else c, zorder=3, edgecolor='none')
    if r.aa in 'KRDE' or aro:
        ax.annotate(f"{r.aa}{r.resi}", (r.resi,r.z_tip), fontsize=7.4,
                    xytext=(0,6), textcoords='offset points', ha='center', color='#333')
for s,e,lab,c in [(111,129,'TM1','#555'),(138,155,'TM2','#555'),(130,137,'loop 130-137\nRKGSKFKK','#b45309')]:
    ax.axvspan(s,e,color=c,alpha=0.10,zorder=2)
    ax.text((s+e)/2, 32, lab, ha='center', fontsize=9, color=c)
ax.text(196,14,'IMS leaflet\ninterface',fontsize=8,color='#7a6a3a',va='center')
ax.text(196,-14,'matrix leaflet\ninterface',fontsize=8,color='#7a6a3a',va='center')
ax.set_xlabel('Residue number (human MIC27 / APOOL, Q6UXV4)')
ax.set_ylabel('Depth along TM-hairpin axis, side-chain tip (A)')
ax.set_title('A. Basic (blue), acidic (red) and aromatic (green) residues\nby membrane depth in the AlphaFold model', fontsize=10.5, loc='left')
ax.set_xlim(94,200); ax.set_ylim(-36,38)

ax=axes[1]
labels=['human MIC27','orangutan','mouse','cow','chicken','platypus','opossum','anole',
        'X. tropicalis','zebrafish','cod','C. elegans MIC27','yeast Mic27','yeast Mic26','human MIC26','mouse MIC26']
grid=["RKGSKFKK","RKGSKFKK","RKGSRFKK","RKGSRFKR","RKDSRFKK","RRGSRWKK","KNGSKFKK","RKGSRLKK",
      "RKGSRLKK","RKGSRLKR","RKGSRFKR","KRGPVGRL","NRSNWGAK","RRRTWLLR","R-GSKIKK","R-GSKIKK"]
cmap={'K':'#2563eb','R':'#1d4ed8','N':'#9aa3ad','G':'#d4d4d8','S':'#d4d4d8','T':'#d4d4d8',
      'F':'#16a34a','W':'#16a34a','L':'#86efac','I':'#86efac','V':'#86efac','P':'#e9d5ff','A':'#d4d4d8','-':'#ffffff'}
for i,(lab,g) in enumerate(zip(labels,grid)):
    for j,c in enumerate(g):
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j,-i),1,1,facecolor=cmap.get(c,'#eee'),edgecolor='white',lw=1.2))
        ax.text(j+0.5,-i+0.5,c,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,
                color='white' if c in 'KRFW' else '#333')
    ax.text(-0.3,-i+0.5,lab,ha='right',va='center',fontsize=8.5)
for j,p in enumerate(range(130,138)):
    ax.text(j+0.5,1.15,str(p),ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#555')
ax.set_xlim(-6.2,8.4); ax.set_ylim(-len(labels)+0.0,2.1); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('B. The predicted matrix loop basic motif R-[KR]-G-S-[KR]-[FWL]-K-[KR]\nis conserved in vertebrate MIC27 and in mammalian MIC26', fontsize=10.5, loc='left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
